ends.description: The page the run is on after, by its id — or unknown

at.description: Only when failed: the step the method stopped at

message.description: What LinkedIn said, word for word: a notice, an error, an empty state

evidence.description: What the page showed, in LinkedIn's terms

name.description: The entry's heading: the member, or the group's name

participants.description: Everyone the options button names, the signed-in member first

when.description: The last message's time as shown: 7:44 PM, Oct 21, Friday

preview.description: The last message as shown, with its You: or <First name>: prefix

lastSender.description: Who sent the last message, from the preview's prefix; null when it has none

active.description: Whether it is the conversation open on the right

more.description: Whether the list offered to load more
